headline: Discussed Hamden Through Time 240 project events, arts fundraisers, a 2027 budget, and a proposed jazz concert series; no votes recorded.
summary: Doc Martin reviewed what is needed for the November 14th event and the December event for the Hamden Through Time 240 project, which is open to all Hamden residents. Members discussed new projects and fundraisers, the proposed 2027 budget, and a proposal for a Hamden Jazz Concert series. No votes were recorded, and the September 2nd minutes will be approved at the next meeting.
